suitableFor: in-body pull-quotes / callout boxes within long-form article content
definition-style or highlighted quote + short attribution
grouped, background-boxed quotations that break up running prose
notSuitableFor: plain inline quotations that read as normal paragraph text (use default content)
customer testimonials with a photo/avatar (use a cards/profile variant)
hero or banner call-outs with a CTA (use hero-banner)

similarityEvaluation.reason: No existing 'quote' base-block variant exists in this project (prior migrations used carousel, columns, cards, hero, tabs, accordion base blocks only). This article's grey pull-quote callout box (blockquote + one-line attribution) maps 1:1 to the Block Collection 'quote' block's 'Quote (with attribution)' variant, so a first quote variant is created from the vanilla quote block.

usage.notes: Definition-style pull-quote 'Wanderlust \wandelust\ a strong desire to travel.' with attribution 'noun', mid-body in the Western Australia camper-van article. Vanilla quote JS/CSS scaffolded; visual polish (grey box background) applied later by the design expert. REUSED on the Arctic Surfing magazine article for its in-body pull-quote (#text-9c38dac643): '"When rare sunrays pierce through the low clouds, the scenery revelas its vibrancy"'. Arctic's quote is a strict subset - quotation only, NO attribution row and a plain .cmp-text (no .cmp-text--quote grey box) in the source - but the DOM shape is identical, matched by the same article-page selector '.cmp-text:has(blockquote)', the block's optional-attribution branch handles the missing attribution gracefully, and the block CSS renders the same grey callout on both pages. Similarity ~0.9 (purpose/density/image-pattern match; colorScheme unified by the block; structure a subset). REUSED again on the Ski Touring magazine article for its in-body pull-quote (#text-8409619abd): blockquote '"...a mountain face stretching out for a thousand meters covered by a smooth blanket of powder, with the evening sun replicated thousand-fold in the uncountable snow crystals"' + attribution '- Sofia Sjöberg'. This is the GREY-BOX (default) variant: the wrapping .text column carries class .cmp-text--quote, identical to western-australia (unlike arctic-surfing's plain .cmp-text). Matched by the same article-page selector '.cmp-text:has(blockquote)'; the quote-pull parser reads .cmp-text--quote off the wrapping .text column and emits the default grey-box variant. Similarity vs current context ~1.0 (grey, spacious, pull-quote, noimg, quote+attribution all match), well above the 0.8 reuse threshold - no new variant created.
